review_method: Parent and independent validator viewed actual Blender front, side, back, quarter and head-back renders; compared old H2.5 rear view.
observed: One coherent character; no duplicated or mirrored second body observed.
Corrected camera labels correspond to anatomical front, side and back; mesh orientation was not changed.
Long robe, sleeves, hands and feet have inspectable volume.
Rear hair main mass is more continuous than old H2.5; old comb-like fragmented silhouette is improved.
Featureless low-information face is consistent with current design direction, but character mood and game-camera readability are not established.
remaining_visual_issues: Thin loose/loop-like strands remain outside the main hair mass; ends are jagged and hard.
Robe is smooth; hem and side transitions remain provisional.
Hands and feet are rough; side foot reads pointed or last-like rather than clearly bare toes.
An actual large ground plane is included in the downloaded model; it is not only the website viewer grid.
technical_limits: No UV, rig, weights or animation.
Multiple connected components, boundary and nonmanifold edges need further assessment before deformation work.
OBJ component counts may be inflated by export vertex splitting; counts are not semantic body/gown/hair groups.
No Godot/game-camera or runtime validation and no existing character replacement.
next_gate: User reviews silhouette before targeted source-preserving cleanup, semantic separation, UV and PixelLab textures. Do not resume rejected historical cleanup as the new base.
